The following events took place in '''3661 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Agent/Legends|Agents]] with the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] take [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] hero [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Shange]] and some of his followers captive and place them in stasis in the SIS's [[The Tomb]] prison on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="oncefuture">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Once and Future|Belsavis}}</ref>
*Lord [[Raxxus]] is imprisoned on Belsavis. {{C|Approximate date}}<ref name="Old Enemies">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Old Enemies|Belsavis}}</ref>
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]] brings [[Theron Shan]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Monastery/Legends|Monastery]] to learn focus from the [[Order of the Sacred Circle]]. {{C|Approximate date}}<ref name="Monastery date">In [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 4|''The Old Republic—The Lost Suns'' 4]], Theron Shan mentions that Ngani Zho took him to Monastery at the age of five. ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' sets Shan's birth year at [[3666 BBY]], meaning that he visited Monastery around 3661 BBY.</ref>
